Copies a rectangle from one buffer to another, or inside the same buffer, even when the two areas overlap. It is much quicker than copying pixel by pixel, and the way to scroll a picture or to save a part of the screen.

```blitzbasic
;media still buffers/copyrect.png
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
For i = 0 To 5
	Color 255 - i * 40, 80 + i * 30, 60 + i * 30
	Oval 10 + i * 8, 10 + i * 8, 80 - i * 12, 80 - i * 12, 1
Next
CopyRect 0, 0, 100, 100, 130, 40
CopyRect 0, 0, 100, 100, 220, 120
Flip
WaitKey
```

![CopyRect](media/buffers/copyrect.png)
@param source_x      Left edge of the area to copy.
@param source_y      Top edge of the area to copy.
@param width         Width of the area.
@param height        Height of the area.
@param dest_x        Left edge of the target area.
@param dest_y        Top edge of the target area.
@param src_buffer    The buffer to copy from. Defaults to the current buffer.
@param dest_buffer   The buffer to copy to. Defaults to the current buffer.
@gap Parts of the rectangle that lie outside of either buffer are cut off.
